{{Quote|Being a member of a squadron means more than knowing how to fly in a formation.|Netrem Pollard to Nera Dantels|<ref name="Rebellion 13">[[Rebellion 13|''Rebellion'' 13]]</ref>}}
'''Netrem Pollard''' was the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Dagger Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Dagger Squadron]] and led the squadron's assault on [[Bannistar Station]]. Pollard piloted the Black Dagger [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]].

==Biography==
Netrum Pollard was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and part of the team that rescued [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] captivity. He continued to work with Ackbar after, keeping him safe. He was assigned to [[Shantipole Project]] with the [[Commander/Legends|commander]]; after meeting the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Salin Glek]], he did not either trust or like him. However, he had no evidence to base his assumption on, so held his counsel to Ackbar.<ref name="SFS" />

When an Alliance team arrived at Shantipole to hand-deliver a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] to Ackbar, Pollard escorted them to the commander after they were initially barred from proceeding by Glek. During the [[Battle of Roche (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] on the facility by [[District Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]]' forces, Pollard assisted the Alliance team. At one point, he held off an squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to allow the team and Ackbar to escape the Command Base in a [[Lifeboat|life boat]]. He was wounded in the effort, and captured by the Imperial forces. During the team's mission to [[Research Station Shantipole]], they found him in the base's Detention Area.<ref name="SFS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I wouldn't do that if I were you.|Netrem Pollard|<ref name="SFS" />}}
Netrem Pollard's life had been long and hard; he had a scarred face, and [[Death/Legends|death]] held little mystery for him. He had an ageless quality, but people considered him to be sinister on first meeting, although he soon won them over. He was dedicated and loyal to the Alliance. He rarely spoke of his past, but he was a natural leader. However, Pollard was not an ambitious man; while it was believed that he would do well in a command position, Pollard preferred to work in important secondary roles.<ref name="SFS" />

==Skills and abilities==
Pollard was skilled in the use of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], and could [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and use its weapons. He could also repair starships.<ref name="SFS" />

==Equipment==
During his time with Project Shantipole, Pollard carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="SFS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Pollard first appeared in ''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]'', an adventure published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in 1988.<ref name="SFS" /> One of the writers of that adventure, [[Ken Ralston]], previously worked at [[Wikipedia:Games Workshop|Games Workshop]] with game designer [[Tim Pollard]]. When Ralston left GW to work on ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Pollard, as a joke to his departing colleague, told him not to forget to [[Tuckerization|write him into]] the Star Wars universe. Ralston unexpectedly obliged him, creating Lt. Pollard and making him a key part of the adventure.<ref name="Palpatones">{{Facebook|username=rich.handley.3|url=rich.handley.3/posts/10223283778555809|name=[[Rich Handley]] with [[Tim Pollard]]|date=June 16, 2021 11:45|archivefile=File:Palpatones-Dahlney-Pollard.png}}</ref>

A figure of Pollard was released in the summer of 2008 to accompany Hasbro's Dagger Squadron B-wing Fighter toy. His first name was revealed in the toy's assembly manual.<ref name="Legacy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=Dagger Squadron B-wing Fighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tlcvehBwing.asp}}</ref>
